# Ordered case partition for the sharded Autobahn server suite.
#
# `wstest -m fuzzingclient` grows without bound while it drives the 216
# permessage-deflate cases: against every 15-bit peer measured, including a
# third-party one, its RSS crosses 1 GiB by the ninth compression case and
# peaks at 3.5-6.0 GiB, which has OOM-killed it mid-run. Sharding gives each
# fresh tester a bounded slice; the Rust server outlives all of them.
#
# Cap per fresh wstest: 64 for groups 1-10, 9 for groups 12-13. The
# small cap ends a compression shard at the measured 1 GiB crossing rather
# than past it. These caps and this partition are fixed in advance: shard
# boundaries must not be redrawn after seeing a run's outcome.
#
# <shard> <case>
